subject: Day 64: cause-and-effect rattle
bodyText:
Today's focus
Avi is bringing hands to mouth and starting to swipe at what he sees. Day 64 leans into early cause and effect: putting a sound-making object where his own motion produces a result he can notice.

Action items
- Place a light rattle in his hand or set a kick-piano at his feet during alert play so his own movement makes the sound, which is the first cause-and-effect link and motivates more deliberate reaching and kicking. AAP movement guide: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/Movement-Birth-to-Three-Months.aspx
- Confirm that caregivers, grandparents, and any nanny are up to date on Tdap, flu, and COVID-19 before increased contact; pertussis from an adult contact is the vaccine-preventable illness most likely to be fatal to an infant. AAP immunization policy: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/immunizations/aap-policy-on-immunizations/
- Keep logging sleep windows so a loose schedule is ready to anchor by 12-14 weeks, ahead of the 4-month regression. AAP infant sleep: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/sleep/Pages/default.aspx

Watch-fors
- [low concern] Hands-to-mouth and gumming on fists; this is normal oral and motor exploration, not a feeding problem.
- [monitor] Hands that stay persistently fisted without opening, or movement that consistently favors one side; document and raise at the next visit.
- [call within 24h] A new feeding-refusal pattern, or a fever onset you are tracking that has not yet crossed the rectal threshold.
- [call now] Rectal temperature of 100.4F (38.0C) or higher under 90 days, blue lips, labored breathing, or seizure-like activity means call now, and 911 for blue lips.

Enrichment opportunities
- Put a light rattle in his hand or a kick-piano at his feet so his action makes a sound, building the earliest sense that his own movement causes a result. AAP movement guide: https://www.healthychildren.org/English/ages-stages/baby/Pages/Movement-Birth-to-Three-Months.aspx
- Connect those cause-and-effect sounds to your varied live singing, echoing the rattle's beat in a quick clapping tune so the self-made sound ties into participatory music. Trainor infant music study: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22490184/
- Narrate the cause and effect out loud as it happens, naming what he just did in warm parentese and pausing for his reply, so the new motor discovery doubles as a conversational turn. Romeo et al. 2018: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29442613/

Upcoming
- Day 70-76: confirm caregiver Tdap and start a small freezer milk stash if you are returning to work.
- Day 84-91: sleep-consolidation window opens; dim the lights after sunset to seed the routine.
- Day 112-126: 4-month well visit, with RV #2, DTaP #2, Hib #2, PCV #2, and IPV #2.

Developmental milestone check-in
Tap any link to mark it complete. View or change others at https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones

- Smiles on his own to get your attention
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Initiates the smile rather than responding to yours — emerging social agency.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/smiles-to-get-attention/complete

- Chuckles (not yet a full laugh)
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Throaty soft laugh sounds. Precedes the full belly laugh by a few weeks.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/chuckles/complete

- Turns head toward the sound of your voice
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Localizes sound source. Worth raising with the pediatrician if absent at the 4-month visit.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/turns-head-toward-sound/complete

- Makes sounds back when you talk to him
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Conversational turn-taking. Foundation for later vocabulary growth.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/makes-sounds-back/complete

- Opens mouth when she sees the breast or bottle
  AAP window: day 60-120
  What to look for: Anticipatory recognition — feeding is now associated with the sight, not just the sensation.
  Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/milestones/4-months.html
  Mark complete: https://www.noahhshaw.com/baby/milestones/opens-mouth-for-breast/complete
